scope: G6-046 exact-original ready-audio Core primitive182. Component-only; no native scheduler integration or capacity qualification.
implementation: QueuedMedia consumes at most64 ready copies of one original single-source non-local audio packet, matching source Port and PacketCustody metadata by exact Arc identity before any IO. Cross-packet batches cannot share an interval.

Every recipient still calls the existing current source/target, route, subscription, cancellation and immutable deadline admission. The first admitted interval lives only on the synchronous ready-send stack, enabling existing weak original-source reuse; all readers release before outcomes return.

Refused metadata is returned unchanged. Refused(NotReady) may be retried under the original deadline; Submitted is terminal even when the transport callback returns NotReady. No reader or grant is returned, queued or held across an explicit scheduling await.

Ordinary asynchronous origin and completed-delivery observation share private helpers with the new path. Data/local branches retain their existing paths. Actual caller IO must be nonblocking and local submission does not imply remote delivery.
